messages:
anya_sales: FYI — CloudRidge asked for a quick POC this week. Goal: validate mixed chat (approx 70%) + embeddings (30%) at sustained 120 QPS, target p95 latency < 350ms for chat. They require KMS encryption and tenant isolation. Can we run a sandboxed run on a dedicated pool?

ryan_ops: We can schedule on a dedicated pool but need a resource owner and an infra ticket for KMS key access. Ops side: need the exact model hashes, sequence length percentiles, and embedding dims.

anya_sales: I have a spreadsheet from the prospect — sequences: median 64, 95th 256, embeddings 1536 dims. Model they requested is a quantized variant of open-llama-13b-q4. They explicitly asked about cold-start behavior and tail latency.

sam.k: @dmitri_eng can you confirm the quantized variant is supported on the Dedicated pool GPUs we propose? Also what's the expected token throughput for q4 on A10 vs A100?

maria_p: +1 on A10 vs A100 numbers — sales needs a rough cost delta for the quote. If we hit sustained 120 QPS with 64 token avg per request, what's the per-token unit estimate?

dmitri_eng: q4 should run fine on A10s but tail latency will be worse than A100. Rough throughput per GPU: A100 ~ 25–30K tok/s, A10 ~ 10–12K tok/s for that model with batching. For 120 QPS * 64 tokens = ~7680 tok/s sustained -> 1 A10 could be borderline, recommend 1 A100 or 2 A10s with autoscale. Quantization caveats: KV cache memory patterns still matter for 95th = 256.

sam.k: Good. For the runbook let's propose: 1) baseline (single A100, no cache warm) 2) steady state (2x A10s with prefix caching) 3) failure mode (simulate node drop + fallback to hosted model).

maria_p: Cost ask — can we produce an estimated daily cost for the steady-state config? Include KMS requests surcharge.

ryan_ops: Quick calc: steady-state 2x A10 reserved-ish = about $X/hour (placeholder) -> ~ $Y/day. KMS adds negligible token cost but has per-request KMS API charge; estimate +5–8%. I'll flag for finance for an exact number.

anya_sales: CloudRidge also sent a security questionnaire — they require HSM-backed CMKs, audit logs, and the ability to rotate keys. Is Private deployment required or can Dedicated with KMS satisfy?

dmitri_eng: HSM-backed CMKs are typically only available via their KMS provider (we support customer-managed keys via cloud KMS/HSM). Dedicated with customer KMS is fine for most items, but if they want on-prem HSM we may need Redwood Private. Note: rotation and audit logs are supported — we'll export audit entries to their logging bucket.

anya_sales: Ok. Two blockers to unblock before run: 1) customer KMS key grant for the test project 2) signed NDA for sending sample PII-ish prompts (they want a small real sample).

sam.k: For the test itself I'll need a short load script — we can use our load harness. Suggest test phases: ramp (5m), steady (30m), spike (5m burst to 300 QPS), soak (2h at 120 QPS), and tail probe (20k short requests to measure p99). Will send the harness link.

loadbot: deploy triggered: load-harness/v2 started on pool-cr-poc, run id 2023-CR-01. See https://internal.redwood.dev/load/2023-CR-01

maria_p: @sam.k can you include exact request mix (70/30) and payload sizes so finance can finalize per-token and infra cost? Also add any expected cache hit rates — that affects billable tokens.

sam.k: Yes — request mix: chat 70% avg tokens 64 (5% >200), embed 30% single vector 1536 dim. Cache hit: assume 12% prefix KV hit initially, 30% after warmup. Will attach the JSON config: 
```
{
  "qps":120,
  "mix": {"chat":0.7, "embed":0.3},
  "seq_p50":64,
  "seq_p95":256,
  "warmup":300,
  "burst":300
}
```

dmitri_eng: One more technical note: enable continuous batching with max_batch_size=128 and target_latency_slo=0.35s. Also set KV cache TTL to 900s for the soak. We'll capture per-route latency histograms.

ryan_ops: I've created infra ticket INF-4821 to request the dedicated pool & KMS IAM grants. ETA for provisioning: ~10–14 hours after KMS keys are attached.

anya_sales: I'll send the NDA and sample prompts today. Ask CloudRidge to provide the KMS key ARN and grant test principal: redwood-poc@cloud.

maria_p: Once we have results can we provide a 1-page summary for the AE with p50/p95/p99, token cost estimate, and recommended config (A100 vs 2xA10)? AE needs that for tomorrow's exec sync.

sam.k: Copy — I'll run the harness and post a short results thread with screenshots of the dashboard and the attach CSV. Expect initial results ~ tomorrow morning.

anya_sales: Thanks all. If any blocker pops, ping me @channel :hand:
